lead_raw_text:
The structure of Pr2Mg10Sn2 (reduced formula PrMg5Sn) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 14 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for all centers: each Mg, Pr, and Sn atom has 12 geometric neighbors, with Mg–Mg distances spanning roughly 3.12–3.43 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component containing all 14 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis shows Mg-centered 12-vertex coordination polyhedra sharing corners, edges, and faces with one another, while Mg and Pr polyhedra also share edges.
